BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has purchased 1,310,890 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities. The purchases, made from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc, occurred on April 8, 2026, with prices ranging from 854.2000 to 883.8000 pence per share, and a volume-weighted average price of 868.7000 pence per share. These transactions are part of a share buyback program announced on March 2, 2026, which is expected to conclude by June 5, 2026. All purchased shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 08 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
